title: PromptHeader
description: The YAML header at the top of every prompt file in prompts/ (blueprint section 12, ADR-0029). It names the prompt, says what it is for and which context sections it expects, and records who owns it and where it came from. A header never grants permissions.

id.description: Unique across prompts/, for example system.base. Recorded with the prompt's hash in run provenance.

inputs.description: The context sections this prompt expects the model to be given. A name that is not a section is rejected.

output_schema.description: The schema the model's output must satisfy, when the prompt asks for structured output.

origin.description: Who wrote this version: a person, or the improvement loop (blueprint section 9).
